description: This file declares the NarratorAnnouncementHostFactory class, which provides static methods to create and manage narrator announcement hosts based on OS version, encapsulating the construction details and maintaining static state.

classes.name: NarratorAnnouncementHostFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating and managing narrator announcement host instances, adapting to OS version differences.

methods.name: MakeHost
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of INarratorAnnouncementHost appropriate for the current OS version.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Performs static initialization tasks for the factory.

methods.name: GetHostProducer
methods.description: Returns the current host producer instance.
